name: Failed v2 RFC callback for invalid RTP transition - DS-12P positive compliant
description:
Test v2 RFC callback DS12P with CNCL status applied twice on the same RTP.

Flow:
1. Activate payer
2. Send an RTP via GPD message v2 (CREATE VALID)
3. Cancel the RTP via GPD message v2 (DELETE) -> RTP to RFC_SENT
4. Send DS12P callback with CxlStsId CNCL (Cancelled As Per Request) -> RTP to CANCELLED
5. Send the same DS12P CNCL callback again on the already cancelled RTP
6. Verify the second callback is rejected (400) since the transition is no longer valid
7. Verify RTP status remains CANCELLED
